description: Any FRED economic series (inflation, unemployment, GDP, payrolls, rates, credit spreads, oil, FX, money supply, recession indicators) by id or plain words, as dates and values, optionally as changes or year-over-year rates. as_of reads it as published on a past date (ALFRED vintages: before later revisions), and revisions shows each value then against now. Feed values straight into analysis tools.

as_of.description: The series as it was published on this date (ALFRED's vintage): only what had been released by then, at the values then shown, before later revisions.

last.description: Only the most recent n observations.

revisions.description: With as_of: each date's value then against today's, and how much it was revised.

series.description: A FRED series id (DGS10, CPIAUCSL, UNRATE) or plain words ("core inflation", "10 year treasury yield").

transform.description: level (default), change from the previous observation, pct_change (fraction), or yoy (fraction against the value a year earlier).

name: economic_series

outputSchema.description: dates and values are the observations, oldest first; with as_of, as they were published that day.

title: Economic series (FRED)
